vibe_rationale: Established, maker-only community market curated for handmade goods, but broad and family-friendly with little subculture signal.
fit_notes: Handmade and local-maker shoppers, adults and families, with free entry; a generic crowd with little health relevance. The three partners are councils and the park service, so no brand partnership is recorded, but a low-cost stall or sampling spot is a steady monthly presence.
